# H2ODB — Sum by Passenger Count

```{tags} reference, query-template, h2odb
```

> [H2ODB](../../h2odb.md) benchmark · [all H2ODB queries](index.md)

SUM(fare_amount) GROUP BY passenger_count

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT passenger_count, SUM(fare_amount) AS sum_fare_amount FROM trips GROUP BY passenger_count ORDER BY passenger_count
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def q3_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Q3: SUM(fare_amount) GROUP BY passenger_count."""
    trips = ctx.get_table("trips")
    col = ctx.col
    return (
        trips.group_by("passenger_count").agg(col("fare_amount").sum().alias("sum_fare_amount")).sort("passenger_count")
    )
```
